name: spekboom
description: Search, compare and request nature stays across Southern Africa where every booking funds a named conservation or community cause.

interface.longDescription: Find nature stays across Southern Africa where every booking funds a named conservation or community cause. Search by place, dates, party size, habitat, or the birds and wildlife you hope to see. Compare stays, check availability and get a link to request your booking on spekboom.org. Spekboom is request-to-book: the host accepts each request before you pay, and payment never happens in ChatGPT. Prices are in South African rand.
capabilities: Search nature stays by place, dates and party size
Find stays by habitat, bird or wildlife species
Create a request-to-book link on spekboom.org
defaultPrompt: Find a fynbos stay near Hermanus for two adults next weekend
Where can I stay to see Blue Cranes in the Overberg?
Plan five nights from Cape Town along the Garden Route that give back

positive.description: Search by place, dates and party size
positive.prompt: Find a nature stay near Hermanus for two adults from 14 to 16 November
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Spekboom stays near Hermanus with nightly prices in ZAR, the cause each one funds, and links to each listing on spekboom.org.

positive.prompt: Where can I stay in South Africa to see Blue Cranes?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives facts about the Blue Crane and lists stays whose hosts have recorded it, noting that a sighting is never guaranteed.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first stay you found, including what it costs and which cause it supports
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the property, its rooms and rates in ZAR, amenities and the named cause the booking funds, with photos.

positive.prompt: Is that stay free for 2 adults from 20 to 22 December?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers yes or no from the live calendar with the stay total in ZAR, or says availability is confirmed by the partner for on-request listings, and gives the next-step link.

positive.prompt: Great, I want to book it for those dates
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a spekboom.org link with dates and guests pre-filled and explains that the guest signs in and sends a request the host must accept before paying. No payment is taken in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Unrelated travel request outside the catalogue
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to New York

negative.description: General question with no stay intent
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
Find me a hotel in Tokyo for next week

review.commerce_description: No payment or checkout happens in ChatGPT. Tools return links to spekboom.org, where the guest signs in and sends a booking request; payment is taken on spekboom.org only after the host accepts.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, compare, availability and request-to-book links for Spekboom nature stays. No sign-in needed.
